identity.title: Retire the egui host after switch-over

context_capsule.purpose_for_a_reader_without_history: After the new shell is the shipping app and parity is proven, egui, eframe and wgpu leave the native product and its test and packaging paths, with an Operator-approved removal list and a rollback point.

closure_unit.outcome: After the new shell is the shipping app and parity is proven, egui, eframe and wgpu leave the native product and its test and packaging paths, with an Operator-approved removal list and a rollback point.

materialized_acceptance.text: Switch-over happened first in one recorded commit (MT-199): installer, launcher, CI and docs point at the new shell, MT-202 is PASS on that candidate, and the previous release binary and tag are retained for rollback.

Feature census: every workflow, control, author id and setting of the egui host maps to a new-shell owner with its proof, or to an explicit Operator-approved drop; the census is attached and nothing is marked dropped by default (Q8).

No product frontend manifest or lock resolves any of egui, eframe, egui-winit, egui-wgpu, egui_tiles, epaint, ecolor, emath, egui_kittest, kumihimo-egui, cabinet-egui, cabinet-peak-egui, handshake_context_menu_egui, wgpu, wgpu-core, wgpu-hal, glow in normal or build dependencies, and the toolkit_spike, egui test harness crates and [patch.crates-io] entries for eframe, egui-wgpu and accesskit_windows are gone.

Every test that names egui (171 of 218 files under handshake_native/tests and the composition_tests crate at 71cc3b6d) is replaced by a toolkit-free or shell-conformance test or is listed with the acceptance it covered; the total acceptance covered does not fall.
Persisted settings, layout, keymap and session written by the egui host open in the new shell; downgrade behaviour is documented.
Argus method JSON, author ids and Palmistry identity match the egui host; a fresh freeze and crash of the new shell produce survivor records (repeat of MT-202 evidence on the retired host's absence).
Removal is executed only from a list the Operator approved in chat as 'approved' or 'proceed', with a recoverable branch and an artifact of the last egui release; nothing else is deleted.
UserManual, module docs and the installer bundle policy name only the new shell.

execution.start_precondition: All dependencies PASS on the switch-over candidate and the Operator has approved the exact removal list in chat. Until then this MT is planning only: the census may start, nothing is removed.

Another lane's uncommitted files; shared files without a recorded single-writer hand-over
Removing a feature, test or adapter that has no recorded replacement
Deleting any local branch, worktree or tag; any git clean or reset

implementation_steps.step: S1 (first slice; no removal): produce the feature and test census JSON (egui host control, author id, setting, test file -> new owner and proof) under the artifact root and attach its hash here; verify counts against the measured baseline.
S2: test migration map: every egui-named test -> replacement test or recorded coverage.
S3: switch-over verification: installer, CI, launcher and docs point to the new shell; rollback artifact and tag recorded.
S4: list every file, crate, dependency, patch and manifest line to remove; Operator approval in chat.
S5: remove in small commits on the product branch, each compiling; run the closure check after each.
S6: verify persisted-state compatibility and final closure; update UserManual.

hbr_obligations.obligation_or_reason: Only the new shell hosts surfaces.
Each control and action declared once with a stable id that feeds GUI, AccessKit, Argus and UserManual.
All GPU work through the MT-203 owner: admission, budget, retained accounting, exactly-once release, typed loss.
Every cache, queue and buffer bounded and accounted, with overload, cancel, stale-revision and release behaviour.
GUI actions, states, errors and GPU failures through the existing internal_diagnostics allowlist, content-free.
Repeat the survival proof on the new shell alone.
Every command carries actor/session, command id, revision and correlation; correlation grants nothing.
Shared edges, dividers, keyboard, focus, IME, AccessKit, DPI, multiwindow, recovery and truthful states.
Validator drives the running surface through Argus (stable author_id, no foreground).
Renderer error scan on every captured frame: Vulkan validation messages and runtime errors; any error fails.
Capture matrix: normal, constrained viewport, and empty/error/loading/multi-item states.
Trace projection where there is no direct surface.
A surface Argus cannot see or steer is repaired in this MT or recorded as a blocking gap.
Automated runs use a quiet, never-activated window or offscreen frame; zero focus or Z-order change.
No OS input injection, cursor movement or foregrounding on any path, tests included.
Background launches record owner and are reclaimed; no orphan windows or processes.
A step that needs the foreground (real OS IME typing) is declared first and run by the Operator.
Three-tier diagnostic outcome recorded per tier (hbr_int_009_tier_obligations).
One owning module in execution.module_ref; write scope derives from its roots; dependency direction stated.
Warm rebuild time and relinked test binaries recorded for the candidate.
Mechanic consumed from its single existing owner (context_capsule.consumed_capability_refs).
No new canonical mechanic without a spec primitive and an owner search.
Accountable owner and independently selectable source, dependency, build, test and artifact closure.
Exact embedding adapter; host policy stays in Handshake.
Asset change lands in its canonical repository and is re-read before any host write.
Missing shared logic is added to the asset first; no host workaround, copy or fork.
Scope linkage preserved on every projected resource.
Default deny kept for missing, stale or revoked context at every boundary touched.
Concurrent accounts see neither content nor existence metadata of each other.
Logout, switch or revocation clears or fences caches, captures, snapshots and stale UI state.
Concurrent agents plus Operator edits: no silent last-writer-wins; conflicts are typed.
Cargo target under the one artifact root, owner-scoped, named in the dispatch (KB-OUT-008).
Owner cleans only its own scoped artifact folder.
UserManual updated in the same change; MANUAL_VERSION bumped where declared.
A no-context model can operate the surface from the manual alone.
Manual entries are code-truthful and self-consistency tested.
